bibliographic-data.invention-title: OBTURATEUR NASAL, MASQUE ET ENSEMBLE D'INTERFACE RESPIRATOIRE
NASAL SEAL, MASK AND RESPIRATORY INTERFACE ASSEMBLY

abstract.p: A nasal seal, comprising:a seal body defining a breathing chamber;a nasal port in the seal body; andwherein the nasal seal comprises a pair of thickened wall portions that, in use,contact the user's cheeks, the thickened wall portions each comprising a groove within the thickened wall portion that allows decoupled movement of portions of the thickened wall portion on opposing sides of the groove.
